newsitem.title: UK: Bass shares up further, NatWest positive.
newsitem.headline: Bass shares up further, NatWest positive.

text.p: Shares in Bass Plc rose on Tuesday, extending yesterday's gains amid positive comment from analysts at NatWest Securities, traders said.

The stock was up 14p at 817-1/2 by 1103 GMT, after on Monday closing up 14-1/2p amid hopes that its proposed purchase of brewer Carlsberg-Tetley would be approved with conditions after being referred to the Monopolies and Mergers Commission.

Market sources said NatWest argued that the referral had been expected and would ultimately be approved with disposals. Sources said NatWest also raised the possibility of a share buyback or special dividend from Bass.
Analysts at NatWest were not immediately available for comment.
